19	// eligibleImport pairs a just-selected agent with its importer and the number
20	// of sessions discoverable for the current repo within the lookback window.
21	type eligibleImport struct {
22		imp          agentimport.Importer
23		displayName  string
24		sessionCount int
25	}
26	
27	// Seams for testing the orchestration in maybeOfferSessionImport without disk
28	// discovery, a real TTY, or real checkpoint writes. Production wiring uses the
29	// real implementations below.
30	var (
31		sessionImportDiscover = discoverImportableAgents
32		sessionImportPrompt   = promptImportSelection
33		sessionImportRun      = runSelectedImports
34	)
35	
36	// maybeOfferSessionImport offers, on first-time enable only, to import
37	// pre-existing agent history for the just-selected agents. Granularity is
38	// agent-level: choosing an agent imports all its discoverable sessions (30-day
39	// lookback, matching `entire import`). It is best-effort — discovery or import
40	// failures are logged and reported to the user but never fail enable.
41	//
42	// Interactive runs present a multi-select with nothing pre-checked, so import
43	// only happens when the user actively selects agents. Non-interactive runs
44	// (`--yes` or no TTY) auto-import all eligible agents.
45	func maybeOfferSessionImport(ctx context.Context, w io.Writer, agents []agent.Agent, opts EnableOptions, firstRun bool) {
46		if !firstRun {
47			return
48		}
49	
50		repoRoot, err := paths.WorktreeRoot(ctx)
51		if err != nil {
52			// No worktree root => nothing to import against. Enabling still succeeds.
53			logging.Warn(ctx, "session import offer skipped: no worktree root", "error", err)
54			return
55		}
56	
57		eligible := sessionImportDiscover(ctx, agents, repoRoot)
58		if len(eligible) == 0 {
59			return
60		}
61	
62		selected := eligible
63		if !opts.Yes && interactive.CanPromptInteractively() {
64			selected, err = sessionImportPrompt(ctx, w, eligible)
65			if err != nil {
66				// Best-effort: a prompt/UI failure must never fail enable. Log,
67				// note it, and skip import.
68				logging.Warn(ctx, "session import offer skipped: prompt failed", "error", err)
69				fmt.Fprintf(w, "Note: could not show import prompt: %v\n", err)
70				return
71			}
72		}
73		if len(selected) == 0 {
74			return
75		}
76	
77		sessionImportRun(ctx, w, repoRoot, selected)
78	}

80	// discoverImportableAgents keeps the selected agents that have a registered
81	// importer and at least one discoverable session for the repo.
82	func discoverImportableAgents(ctx context.Context, agents []agent.Agent, repoRoot string) []eligibleImport {
83		now := time.Now()
84		var out []eligibleImport
85		for _, ag := range agents {
86			imp := importerForAgent(ag)
87			if imp == nil {
